### Wyoming Corporate Income Tax Status (Tax Years 2025 and 2026)

The State of Wyoming does not levy a corporate income tax (rate is 0% / $0). Under Wyoming Statutes Title 39, Chapter 12 (W.S. § 39-12-101), the state preempts the field of income taxes and prohibits political subdivisions from levying any tax on income. Consequently, the Wyoming Department of Revenue does not administer a corporate income tax or business income apportionment.

---

### 1. Corporate Income / Franchise Tax Nexus & Bright-Line Thresholds

* **Fact:** **Not found.** The State of Wyoming does not impose a corporate income tax or a net income-based corporate franchise tax (see Wyo. Const. art. 15, § 18; W.S. Title 39). Consequently, there are no statutory provisions, administrative rules, or bright-line economic nexus thresholds creating corporate income or franchise tax nexus in Wyoming. *(Note: Under W.S. § 17-16-1630, an annual report license tax administered by the Secretary of State applies to entities organized or authorized to do business in the state based on capital, property, and assets employed in Wyoming, but this is neither an income-based tax nor administered by the Department of Revenue).*
* **Applicable Tax Years:** 2025 and 2026 (no change between years).
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Wyoming Legislature Title 39 Statutes: https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf
  * Wyoming Department of Revenue: https://revenue.wyo.gov/

---

### 2. Remote Seller Economic Nexus Threshold & Measurement Period

* **Fact:** Under W.S. § 39-15-501(a), any seller of tangible personal property, admissions, or services subject to sales tax who does not have a physical presence in Wyoming must remit sales tax if the seller meets the economic nexus criteria:
  * **Sales Dollar Threshold:** Gross revenue from the sale of tangible personal property, admissions, or services delivered into Wyoming exceeds **$100,000.00** (W.S. § 39-15-501(a)(i)).
  * **Transaction Count Threshold:** **None** for tax years 2025 and 2026. The 200 or more separate transactions threshold previously codified at W.S. § 39-15-501(a)(ii) was repealed effective July 1, 2024, by 2024 House Bill 0197 (Laws 2024, ch. 67, § 2).
  * **Measurement Period:** The **current calendar year or the immediately preceding calendar year** (W.S. § 39-15-501(a)).
* **Applicable Tax Years:** 2025 and 2026 (the repeal of the 200-transaction threshold occurred July 1, 2024, and remains in effect for 2025 and 2026 without change between them).
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Wyoming Legislature Title 39 Statutes: https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf
  * Wyoming Legislature 2024 HB 0197 / Enrolled Act No. 38 (Laws 2024, ch. 67): https://wyoleg.gov/Legislation/2024/HB0197

---

### 3. State Position on Public Law 86-272 Protection

* **Fact:** **Not found.** Public Law 86-272 protects businesses from state net income taxation when activities in the state are limited to solicitation of sales of tangible personal property. Because Wyoming levies no corporate net income tax, P.L. 86-272 is inapplicable, and no position statement or guidance exists on the Department of Revenue website or in the Wyoming Statutes.
* **Applicable Tax Years:** 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Wyoming Department of Revenue: https://revenue.wyo.gov/
  * Wyoming Legislature Statutes: https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf

### 1. Individual Income Tax Rate(s)
* **Fact:** Wyoming imposes no individual income tax (0% rate). Under Article 15, Section 18 of the Wyoming Constitution, no tax may be levied upon income without allowing a full credit for all sales and use taxes paid to the state or its political subdivisions.
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both tax year 2025 and tax year 2026 (no change).
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Wyoming Legislative Service Office (Statutory Tax Structure Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-20250603TaxStructureOverview.pdf
  * Wyoming Statutes (Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf

---

### 2. Corporate Income Tax and Corporate License / Franchise Tax
* **Corporate Income Tax Rate:** Wyoming does not impose a corporate income tax (0% rate; $0 collections). 
* **Corporate License Tax (Franchise Tax):** While the Wyoming Department of Revenue does not collect a corporate franchise or income tax, the state levies an annual report license tax on corporations and limited liability companies administered through the Secretary of State under Wyo. Stat. § 17-16-1630(a) and § 17-29-209(a). The tax is calculated on the sum of capital, property, and assets located and employed in Wyoming at:
  * Minimum tax: $60.00
  * Variable rate: Two-tenths of one mill on the dollar ($0.0002) of assets located and employed in the state, whichever is greater.
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both tax year 2025 and tax year 2026 (no change).
* **Official URLs:**
  * Wyoming Legislative Service Office (Statutory Tax Structure Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-20250603TaxStructureOverview.pdf
  * Wyoming Statutes (Title 17 - Corporations, Partnerships, and Associations): https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title17.pdf

---

### 3. State Sales and Use Tax Rate & Local Rates
* **State Rate:** The statewide sales and use tax rate is 4.0% (comprising an excise tax of 3% pursuant to Wyo. Stat. § 39-15-104(a) / § 39-16-104(a) plus an additional 1% pursuant to Wyo. Stat. § 39-15-104(b) / § 39-16-104(b)).
* **Local Option Rates:** Local jurisdictions (counties) may impose additional local option sales and use taxes of 0% to 3% (such as general-purpose, specific-purpose, or economic development excise taxes under Wyo. Stat. § 39-15-204 and § 39-16-204).
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both tax year 2025 and tax year 2026 (no change).
* **Official URLs:**
  * Wyoming Legislative Service Office (Statutory Tax Structure Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-20250603TaxStructureOverview.pdf
  * Wyoming Statutes (Title 39 - Taxation and Revenue): https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf
  * Wyoming Department of Revenue (Excise Tax Division): https://revenue.wyo.gov/divisions/excise-tax

---

### 4. Gross Receipts, Margin, or Other Notable Business Taxes
* **Gross Receipts / Margin Tax:** Wyoming does not impose a general gross receipts tax or corporate margin tax.
* **Notable Specific Business Taxes:**
  * **Mineral Severance Tax (Wyo. Stat. Title 39, Chapter 14):** Levied on mineral extraction and administered by the Department of Revenue Mineral Tax Division. Rates include:
    * Crude oil: 6%
    * Natural gas: 6%
    * Surface coal: 6.5% for the first half of 2025; reduced to 6.0% effective July 1, 2025 (and continuing in 2026) pursuant to 2025 Session Law, Chapter 31
    * Underground coal: 3.75%
    * Trona: 4%
    * Uranium: 0% to 5% (2021–2025)
    * Other valuable deposits: 2%
  * **Wind Generation Tax (Wyo. Stat. § 39-22-104):** $1.00 per megawatt-hour produced, beginning 3 years after a wind turbine first produces electricity.
* **Tax Years:** 2025 and 2026 (surface coal severance rate changed from 6.5% to 6.0% effective July 1, 2025).
* **Official URLs:**
  * Wyoming Legislative Service Office (Statutory Tax Structure Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-20250603TaxStructureOverview.pdf
  * Wyoming Statutes (Title 39): https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf
  * Wyoming Department of Revenue: https://revenue.wyo.gov/

notes:
### State Overview: Wyoming Income Taxation (Tax Years 2025 and 2026)

The State of Wyoming does not levy an individual income tax, a corporate income tax, or a pass-through entity income tax. 

* **Constitutional Provision:** Article 15, Section 18 of the Wyoming Constitution provides: *"No tax shall be imposed upon income without allowing full credit against such tax liability for all sales, use, and ad valorem taxes paid in the taxable year by the same taxpayer to any taxing authority in Wyoming."* 
  * **Official Source:** [Wyoming Constitution (Title 97)](https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title97.pdf)
* **Statutory Framework:** Wyoming Statutes Title 39, Chapter 12 contains only W.S. § 39-12-101 (*Preemption by state*), which preempts local jurisdictions from levying income taxes, while the state itself levies no income tax. 
  * **Official Source:** [Wyoming Statutes Title 39 (Taxation and Revenue)](https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf)
* **State Tax Structure:** The Wyoming Legislative Service Office (LSO) tax structure report confirms that for Individual Income Tax and Corporate Income Tax, the base rate is **0%** and collections are **$0**. The Wyoming Department of Revenue consists solely of Excise Tax, Mineral Tax, Property Tax, and Liquor divisions; it has no income tax division.
  * **Official Source:** [Wyoming State Legislature – Wyoming Statutory Tax Structure: Title 39](https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-202506032-01WyomingtaxstructureratesandcollectionsJune32025.pdf)
  * **Official Source:** [Wyoming Department of Revenue](https://revenue.wyo.gov/)
